## About
Road Race Engineering is an EVO and Eclipse shop in Santa Fe Springs. We go racing. We prepare, race and support rally, road racing, time attack, drag and drift cars, and we fix street cars from basic service on up.
The goal is simple: a balanced vehicle that stops and turns as hard as it accelerates. One reviewer put it this way: Robert and Mike are insanely knowledgeable and trustworthy.
Rated 4.6 on Google from 58 reviews. People drive in from all over So Cal after work, so call ahead and plan with us.

## Services
- EVO service: We fix EVOs, from basic service on up.
- Race car support: Rally, road racing, time attack, drag and drift cars. We prepare them, race them and support them.
- Chassis dyno: Cars get dialed in here on the RRE Dynapack Chassis Dyno.
- EVO X Fuel and Tuning Parts: Fuel system and tuning parts for the EVO X.
- RRE EVO X Engine Upgrades: Engine parts for the EVO X from our catalog.
- RRE EVO X Suspension Parts: Suspension parts for the EVO X.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: If you need advice or want your car looked at, yes. Set one up first.

Q: When is the best time to call?
A: Noon to 6pm, California time.

Q: Do you work on stock cars?
A: Yes. We can keep your stock street car serviced and running at its peak.

Q: Where are you?
A: Santa Fe Springs, near the 5, 605 and 105 freeway interchange.

Q: Can I order parts without coming in?
A: Yes. Parts orders can be done by mail, fax or e-mail using our parts order form.
